name: typed-uninitialized
source: <?php class C { public int $x; } echo "B";

name: untyped-null
source: <?php class C { public $x; } echo "B";

name: array-default
source: <?php class C { public array $x = [1, 2]; } echo "B";

name: duplicate-vs-default
source: <?php echo "B"; class C { public int $x=1, $x="bad"; }

name: forbidden-type-vs-duplicate
source: <?php echo "B"; class C { public int $x; public void $x; }
static_message: Property C::$x cannot have type void

name: invalid-default
source: <?php echo "B"; class C { public int $x="bad"; }
static_message: Cannot use string as default value for property C::$x of type int

name: null-default
source: <?php echo "B"; class C { public int $x=null; }
static_message: Default value for property of type int may not be null. Use the nullable type ?int to allow null default value

name: invalid-expression
source: <?php echo "B"; class C { public $x=strlen("a"); }

name: group-second-item
source: <?php class C { public int $a=1, $b="bad"; } echo "B";
static_message: Cannot use string as default value for property C::$b of type int

name: override-compatible-early
source: <?php class A { public int $x=1; } class B extends A { public int $x=2; } echo "B";

name: override-incompatible-early
source: <?php class A { public int $x=1; } class B extends A { public string $x="s"; } echo "B";
static_message: Type of B::$x must be int (as in class A)

name: override-incompatible-forward
source: <?php echo "B"; class B extends A { public string $x="s"; } class A { public int $x=1; }

name: override-untyped-to-typed
source: <?php class A { public $x; } class B extends A { public int $x; } echo "B";
static_message: Type of B::$x must be omitted to match the parent definition in class A

name: override-grandparent-incompatible
source: <?php class A{public int $x;} class B extends A{} class C extends B{public string $x;} echo "Q";
static_message: Type of C::$x must be int (as in class A)

name: override-parent-order
source: <?php class A { public int $x; public int $y; } class B extends A { public string $y; public string $x; } echo "B";
static_message: Type of B::$x must be int (as in class A)

name: override-transitive-own-first
source: <?php class A { public int $x; public int $y; } class B extends A { public int $y; } class C extends B { public string $x; public string $y; } echo "B";
static_message: Type of C::$y must be int (as in class B)

name: readonly-no-type
source: <?php class C { public readonly $x; } echo "B";
static_message: Readonly property C::$x must have type

name: static-readonly
source: <?php class C { public static readonly int $x; } echo "B";
static_message: Static property C::$x cannot be readonly

name: multiline-item
source:
<?php
class C {
 public int $a=1,
 $b="bad";
}
static_message: Cannot use string as default value for property C::$b of type int

name: float-int-default
source: <?php class C { public float $x=1; } echo ((new C)->x === 1.0) ? "F" : "I";

name: union-null
source: <?php class C { public int|string $x=null; } echo "B";
static_message: Default value for property of type string|int may not be null. Use the nullable type string|int|null to allow null default value

name: intersection-null
source: <?php class A{} class B{} class C { public A&B $x=null; } echo "B";
static_message: Cannot use null as default value for property C::$x of type A&B

name: readonly-no-type-default
source: <?php class C { public readonly $x=1; } echo "B";
static_message: Readonly property C::$x must have type

name: readonly-static-default
source: <?php class C { public static readonly int $x=1; } echo "B";
static_message: Readonly property C::$x cannot have default value

name: dnf-null
source: <?php class A{} class B{} class C{} class D { public (A&B)|C $x=null; }
static_message: Default value for property of type (A&B)|C may not be null. Use the nullable type (A&B)|C|null to allow null default value
